sources.scope: General blood-test education: test description and result interpretation sections; not individual diagnosis.

scope: General blood-test education only, with the report's applicable laboratory interval. No pediatric, pregnancy-specific, disease-management or assay-specific targets.
overview: Measures the oxygen-carrying protein in red cells.
high: Lung or heart conditions and increased red-cell production are possible associations; altitude and hydration also matter.
low: Anemia, blood loss and nutrient deficiencies are possible associations.
caveats: Laboratory intervals depend on patient characteristics. The test alone cannot determine the cause; this is not an A1C test.
